chapter.heading: Prayer to God in Time of Trouble
chapter.v:
Vindicate me,
O God,And plead my cause against an ungodly nation;Oh, deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man! [Is. 26:9]

For You
are the God of my strength;Why do You cast me off?Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Oh, send
out Your light and Your truth!Let them lead me;Let them bring me to Your holy hillAnd to Your tabernacle. [Song 5:7; Is.]

Then I
will go to the altar of God,To God my exceeding joy;And on the harp I will praise You,O God, my God. [Song 8:2]

Why are
you cast down, O my soul?And why are you disquieted within me?Hope in God;For I shall yet praise Him,The help of my countenance and my God. [Song 2:7; 8:4]
